title: Public Holidays in Tanzania and How They Affect Your Trip
excerpt: Public holidays in Tanzania can affect banks, offices and border crossings. An overview and what it means for your trip.
body:
## Fixed holidays

- 1 January: New Year's Day
- 12 January: Zanzibar Revolution Day
- 7 April: Karume Day
- 26 April: Union Day
- 1 May: Labour Day
- 7 July: Saba Saba
- 8 August: Nane Nane (Farmers' Day)
- 14 October: Nyerere Day
- 9 December: Independence Day
- 25–26 December: Christmas and Boxing Day

## Moving holidays

- Good Friday and Easter Monday
- Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
- Maulid (the Prophet's birthday)

## Ramadan

Not a public holiday, but daily life changes, especially on Zanzibar. See [what to wear on Zanzibar](/blog/zanzibar-dress-code/).

## Impact

Banks and offices close. Parks and lodges operate normally.

Dates can change; check before you travel. [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
